implemented.trustGuard: An untrusted workspace refuses to start an analysis (MSBuild evaluation and project logic) and offers Manage Trust; stored results stay viewable because they are data only.
implemented.csp: default-src 'none'; nonce-only scripts; no unsafe-eval and no remote origins; worker-src blob:; connect-src limited to the webview's own resources; object-src, frame-src, base-uri, form-action 'none'. Generated in src/view/csp.ts and unit-tested.
implemented.panelOptions: enableCommandUris: false and enableForms: false are explicit.
implemented.queryBound: Search queries are capped at 200 characters before the store is touched.
implemented.pathContainment: Relative paths with .. escapes, absolute paths, or invalid segments are rejected. Linked files outside the root still open, but their content is not read for hash comparison.
implemented.textSanitising: Type names and labels are collapsed to one line; Mermaid quotes and backticks are neutralised so a hostile name cannot break the format.

cases: trust decision refuses untrusted workspaces with an action
path containment accepts inside/./..-normalised paths and rejects escapes, absolute paths, invalid segments
CSP has no eval/remote origin and locks objects, frames, base, forms
search query longer than the limit is rejected
hostile names stay inert in context, JSON, and Mermaid
